description: Source file for a PyTorch benchmarks module, specifically implementing microbenchmarks for `scaled_grouped_mm` operator in `torch.nn.functional`. It includes class definitions for setting up and executing benchmark configurations for various scaled grouped matrix multiplications, with support for FP8 and other quantized formats, and conditional configurations based on hardware and software capabilities.

classes.name: ScaledGroupedMMBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for scaled grouped matrix multiplication operator, supports initialization with various scaling modes and input shapes, and executes the performance tests.
